tasks.label: BACKEND
tasks.command: until pg_isready -h postgres -p 5432 -U dns_zone_manager -d dns_zone_manager 2>/dev/null; do echo 'Waiting for postgres (start the POSTGRES task if it is not running)...'; sleep 2; done && go run ./cmd/dns-zone-manager serve --config .devcontainer/config.devcontainer.yaml --ui-dir dist

tasks.label: BIND
tasks.command: proj="${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-dns-zone-manager-go_devcontainer}"; bind="${proj}-bind-1"; sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" up -d bind && sudo docker exec "$bind" mkdir -p /etc/bind/zones-source && sudo docker cp /workspace/.devcontainer/named.conf.devcontainer "${bind}:/etc/bind/named.conf" && sudo docker cp /workspace/examples/bind/zones/. "${bind}:/etc/bind/zones-source/" && sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" logs --tail 100 -f bind

tasks.label: POSTGRES
tasks.command: proj="${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-dns-zone-manager-go_devcontainer}"; sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" up -d --no-recreate postgres && sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" logs --tail 100 -f postgres

tasks.label: LGTM
tasks.command: proj="${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-dns-zone-manager-go_devcontainer}"; lgtm="${proj}-lgtm-1"; sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" up -d lgtm && sudo docker exec "$lgtm" mkdir -p /otel-lgtm/grafana/conf/provisioning/dashboards/custom && sudo docker cp /workspace/examples/observability/otelcol-config.yaml "${lgtm}:/otel-lgtm/otelcol-config.yaml" && sudo docker cp /workspace/examples/observability/dashboards/provisioning.yaml "${lgtm}:/otel-lgtm/grafana/conf/provisioning/dashboards/custom.yaml" && sudo docker cp /workspace/examples/observability/dashboards/dns-zone-manager.json "${lgtm}:/otel-lgtm/grafana/conf/provisioning/dashboards/custom/dns-zone-manager.json" && sudo docker cp /workspace/examples/observability/dashboards/performance.json "${lgtm}:/otel-lgtm/grafana/conf/provisioning/dashboards/custom/performance.json" && sudo docker restart "$lgtm" && echo '\nGrafana: http://localhost:3000  (Loki + metrics dashboards)\n' && sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" logs --tail 100 -f lgtm

tasks.label: Shutdown All
tasks.command:
echo '
📋 To stop all running services:

   Press Ctrl+Shift+P → "Terminal: Kill All Terminals"

   Or click the trash icon in each terminal panel.
'

tasks.label: Rebuild Dev Container
tasks.command:
echo '
📋 To rebuild the dev container:

   1. Stop services: Ctrl+Shift+P → "Terminal: Kill All Terminals"
   2. Rebuild: Ctrl+Shift+P → "Dev Containers: Rebuild Container"

This will rebuild the container image and restart all services.
'
